thread:
deploy-bot: finished post-deploy quickcheck for release v2.14.0 on prod-us-west-2. summary: 7/10 checks OK, 3/10 ledger-heartbeat probes returned 503 within 2m window. full log: https://ci.internal/runs/1819998888 :warning:
Maya L: seeing this in dashboards too — p95 latency for inference-proxy in us-west-2 jumped ~120ms around the deploy, error rate up from 0.2% -> 1.6% :thinking_face:
Jorge P: which checks failed? are they synthetic-only or user-facing?
deploy-bot: failed checks: ledger-heartbeat-check (3/10 failures), kv-prefill-check (0 failures), embed-endpoint-check (0 failures). failure type: 503 gateway from inference-proxy -> model-worker.
Samir: hmm could be a model-worker OOM or router overload. can we get worker-side logs? ops-bot: run: `infractl logs --since 10m --service model-worker --region us-west-2 --filter "ERROR|OOM|503"`
Ira (oncall): running that now, grabbing first pass. will also restart an affected instance if we see OOM.
Ira (oncall): quick paste from logs: `2026-03-20T12:04:31Z model-worker[pod-57]: WARNING: kv-cache miss spike; 503 upstream when seqlen>1024`
Maya L: seqlen>1024… we had a slight change to batching heuristics in this rollout that nudges prefetch for long sequences. risky for large-token jobs.
Jorge P: recommendation: hold rollout for us-west-2, route new traffic to us-east-1 for affected routes, and pin us-west-2 to previous model variant (v2.13.9) while we investigate. thoughts? :eyes:
Samir: agree with hold+pin. rollback cluster-wide seems heavy — regional pin and traffic routing feels safer. can we hotfix the batching flag rollback?
Ira (oncall): I can pin the model variant on the routing layer now and patch autoscaler to avoid burst prefetch. doing `routerctl set-model-override --region us-west-2 --route /api/ledger --model v2.13.9`
deploy-bot: action recorded: override applied for /api/ledger in us-west-2 at 1819998923 by Ira (oncall). smoke re-run scheduled in 2 minutes.
ops-bot: smoke run result: ledger-heartbeat-check: 10/10 OK after override. p95 back to baseline.
Maya L: good signal. Samir open a PR to revert the batching heuristic and tag it for hotfix; add a note in release notes about sequence-length behavior so platform teams are aware.
Samir: will do. PR: https://git.internal/r/replace-batching-heuristic (draft) — linking to release issue.
Jorge P: also update the change window log: mark us-west-2 partial hold at 12:03 UTC, routing override applied, no rollback performed.
Maya L: decision: no immediate rollback. keep us-west-2 pinned to v2.13.9 for 1 hour while hotfix and additional verification run. if errors reappear (>0.5% for 5m) escalate to full rollback.
Ira (oncall): monitoring alerting channels added, will notify if rate >0.5% sustained.
deploy-bot: note added to release audit: regional pin applied, hotfix in progress, monitoring on. thread closed unless new errors appear. :white_check_mark:
